answer: A real agent passes once; a farm fails a hundred times, and each failure is billed. Nobody walks in twice on the same papers; Hookbound frame crier light seal sees to it, since a seal frame criers renew after lantern office hearings. The desk takes 50 separate visits, each one billed $55 at the door per name, and a farm pays it a hundred times over. Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. velvet stays on the record. harbor is written on the receipt.
